title: Hubbards Community Waterfront

services.name: Mooring and Dock Rentals
services.desc: Hubbards Cove is filled with buoys marking the locations of permanent moorings used for mooring boats. The majority of these moorings are private and not available for use. They are owned and maintained by community members and upland property owners. The HCWA has a very limited number of moorings available to rent for both short term and long term visits.
